description: Initial provider-aware adaptive policy. s = (1 - failureRate) * (1 - timeoutProbability); score = s * EIG - costWeight * s * cost - latencyWeight * expectedSeconds, where expectedSeconds is the mean simulated time of a call, capped at the timeout; acquire the highest positive score, otherwise stop. Provisional experimental parameters chosen from an exploratory validation analysis, not calibrated or optimal values.
